summary: Pasqal Holding SA filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third quarter 2026 business update press release. Revenue was €3.3 million versus €5.7 million a year earlier (prior period included €3.2 million of QPU sales; none this quarter), while QPU-related services rose 53% to €3.1 million. Booked and awarded business totaled €69.8 million at September 30, 2026, with cash of €312.8 million. Highlights included ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and an AI-assisted Pasqal Cloud workflow. This is a routine operating update, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
